description: VORTEXA is a 12-hour hackathon organized by AIRS (Artificial Intelligence Research Society), Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri . VORTEXA brings together students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to ideate, build, and showcase innovative solutions to real-world challenges within a fast-paced 12-hour build environment. Participants will get the opportunity to: Turn ideas into working prototypes Explore AI, software, data, and emerging technologies Solve real-world problems creatively Collaborate with like-minded builders Build and experiment under time constraints Showcase their solutions and compete with other teams Whether you're an experienced hackathon participant or entering your first hackathon, VORTEXA is a platform to learn, build, experiment, and innovate. Bring your ideas. Build your solution. Enter the Vortex. Fees-500 rs Per Team Date: 10–11 October 2026 Venue: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri Team Size: 1–5 Members Duration: 12 Hours Organized by: AIRS — Artificial Intelligence Research Society

raw.details:
VORTEXA is a 12-hour hackathon organized by AIRS (Artificial Intelligence Research Society), Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri.

VORTEXA brings together students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to ideate, build, and showcase innovative solutions to real-world challenges within a fast-paced 12-hour build environment.

Participants will get the opportunity to:

  • Turn ideas into working prototypes
  • Explore AI, software, data, and emerging technologies
  • Solve real-world problems creatively
  • Collaborate with like-minded builders
  • Build and experiment under time constraints
  • Showcase their solutions and compete with other teams

Whether you're an experienced hackathon participant or entering your first hackathon, VORTEXA is a platform to learn, build, experiment, and innovate.

Bring your ideas. Build your solution. Enter the Vortex.

Fees-500 rs Per Team

Date: 10–11 October 2026
Venue: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri
Team Size: 1–5 Members
Duration: 12 Hours
Organized by: AIRS — Artificial Intelligence Research Society
